name: D-29 repulsor rifle
description: The D-29 repulsor rifle was a type of repulsor rifle manufactured by SakTek. Able to knock large targets across a room or ocasionally simuluate high- and low-gravity environments, the large repulsor weapon was tuned to narrow, longer-range areas of effect to maximize effectiveness while reducing power drain, rarely utilized by bounty hunters, law enforcement, and pranksters.
